messages.en:
{07 14 00}Guess what, {04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00} I
just got my {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room
Academy{ff 00 00 00} report card!
{07 0a 00}They said they liked the
way all my furniture
worked together!
{07 0e 00}It must be because I
collected a {ff 00 00 02}complete set{ff 00 00 00}...

Ah, who cares why? All that
matters is that I got
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00}!{03 01 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Arva ära, {04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma
sain just oma {ff 00 00 02}Õnneliku Toa
Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00} tunnistuse!
{07 0a 00}Nad ütlesid, et neile
meeldis, kuidas kogu mu
mööbel kokku sobis!
{07 0e 00}See peab olema sellepärast,
et sain {ff 00 00 02}terve komplekti{ff 00 00 00}...

Ah, keda huvitab? Tähtis on
ainult see, et ma sain
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00}!{03 01 00 01}

a chest of drawers, too,

messages.en:
Guess what the {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room
Academy{ff 00 00 00} told me.

{07 14 00}They said my room had good
feng shui. My room scored
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 00 00}You've got to put the right
color of furniture in the
right area of the room.
messages.et:
Arva ära, mida {ff 00 00 02}Õnneliku Toa
Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00} mulle ütles.

{07 14 00}Nad ütlesid, et mu toas on
hea feng shui. Mu tuba sai
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 00 00}Sa pead panema õiget värvi
mööbli toa õigesse
piirkonda.

messages.en:
Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}would you
like to come visit my
house sometime?
{07 14 00}You know,{01 00 00 05 00} my room has
some really great color
coordination, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}I know, because the {ff 00 00 02}Happy
Room Academy{ff 00 00 00} gave me a
whopping {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}kas sa
tahaksid kunagi mu majja
külla tulla?
{07 14 00}Tead,{01 00 00 05 00} mu toas on
tõesti suurepärane
värvikooskõla, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Ma tean, sest {ff 00 00 02}Õnneliku Toa
Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00} andis mulle
tervelt {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}So,{01 00 00 05 00} I received my {ff 00 00 02}Happy
Room Academy{ff 00 00 00} report card
the other day.
{07 00 00}I tried something new
this time, and it worked
out all right.
{07 0d 00}I got {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Nii et{01 00 00 05 00} ma sain hiljuti oma
{ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00}
tunnistuse.
{07 00 00}Ma proovisin seekord midagi
uut ja see läks
üsna hästi.
{07 0d 00}Ma sain {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00}.

messages.en:
Oh, by the way,{01 00 00 05 00} the {ff 00 00 02}Happy
Room Academy{ff 00 00 00} gave me
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 00 00}I think it's because I have
a lot of very similar items
in my room, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 04 00}I guess I fooled them into
thinking I had some kind of
theme going on!
messages.et:
Oh, muide,{01 00 00 05 00} {ff 00 00 02}Õnneliku Toa
Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00} andis mulle
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 00 00}Ma arvan, et sellepärast,
mul on toas palju väga
sarnaseid asju, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 04 00}Ma vist petsin neid uskuma,
et mul on mingi teema
paigas!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Do you pay any attention
at all to your {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room
Academy{ff 00 00 00} score?
{07 14 00}On my latest report card,
I got {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00}.

{07 0e 00}Maybe it's my imagination,{01 00 00 05 00}
but as soon as I put that
new furniture in my room,
{07 06 00}my score totally shot
through the roof!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Kas sa pöörad üldse
tähelepanu oma {ff 00 00 02}Õnneliku Toa
Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00} punktidele?
{07 14 00}Viimasel tunnistusel sain
ma {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00}.

{07 0e 00}Ehk on see mu kujutlus,{01 00 00 05 00}
aga niipea, kui ma panin
selle uue mööbli tuppa,
{07 06 00}tõusis mu skoor täiesti
lakke!

messages.en:
When I signed up for the
{ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00}, they
scored me right away.
It wasn't a very high score,
but I figured that I'd learn
more as time went by.
{07 16 00}But I'm still not any good
at decorating my room!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0f 00}I'm so bummed, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{03 03 00 01}
messages.et:
Kui ma {ff 00 00 02}Õnneliku Toa
Akadeemiaga{ff 00 00 00} liitusin, andsid
nad mulle kohe punktid.
See polnud kõrge skoor,
aga ma arvasin, et õpin
ajaga rohkem.
{07 16 00}Aga ma pole ikka hea oma
toa kaunistamises!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0f 00}Ma olen nii norus, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{03 03 00 01}
